svg.font-family: Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Lab white-beam (LIGA)
svg.desc: Two lanes ending in shadow printing with no pupil: electrons accelerated to the kVp hit a thick W, Mo, Cu or Rh anode, giving the Kramers continuum and K and L lines that a Be window hardens; a 100 TW laser drives a plasma bubble whose electrons oscillate and emit a femtosecond keV burst.
svg.text: how the light is made → the mask (shadow printing)

g.text: X-ray tube · W / Mo / Cu / Rh anode · bremsstrahlung + K/L lines (LIGA)
LWFA betatron · fs keV burst, ~10 Hz · imaging, not lithography (0.5 nm preset)

svg.text: Hard X-rays are shadow-printed through a mask into thick PMMA: no projection optic, no pupil, no TCC.
